What are some thoughts on a Legend of Zelda MMO game? A quick Google search shows that other people have had this idea, and some versions have been in the works. Is it something Nintendo should look into? Would it be a success?
This is one of those things that has always sounded great in my head and in theory but on paper I just don't know how well the Zelda universe would work as a traditional MMO
What about the Zelda universe do you think holds it back from facilitating an MMO adaptation? What makes a game a "traditional MMO"?

I think that Zelda is very story driven and not very world driven. By that I mean the things that truly sing out to the franchise are the main characters and as a MMO you can't have thousands of "Links and Zelda's" because that does not make a interesting world.

Traditionally you have a lot of races and classes that you can mix and match and sort of make your own and be thrown out into the world to explore and sort of "become your own legend". I think with Zelda it might be harder to get a general audience interested. I, for one, would have balls out great time playing a Goron fire mage/warrior or a sheikah tribe assassin, but I recognize that it's my fandom that really does it for me.

I suppose if they could find a way to get more people to really dive into entire depth of Zelda universe as well as do more than take a MMO and slap Zelda all over it they might be able to make it work.

Dynasty Hyrule Warriors is a good example of taking a style of game and copy/pasting Zelda all over it. Not bad, kinda neat, but not the most memorable, and with the run of MMO giants out and on the way they have got to be noteworthy.

As for the legend of Zelda being a mass multiplayer online game, I personally believe it just wouldn't work!

The gameplay mechanics behind the game itself and the characters just aren't supportive of a Massively multiplayer platform, Take link for example; We associate ourselves with Link as we play through his adventure, Now throw 11 more links on the screen at one time, it just takes away from the mystique of his character, well the idea itself is intriguing it just isn't viable.

Now that being said; with the upcoming release of Legend of Zelda: Triforce Heros we get to see a small glimpse into a multiplayer style zelda game. So who know's what the future holds for the Zelda franchise, the biggest tell tale sign will be the popularity of the much anticipated Wii U title release.
